EmailTemplate.subject: We missed you at our Q4 Product Insights Open Forum!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Sorry we missed you on our Q4 Product Insights Open Forum earlier this week! Our product managers highlighted updates to our education solutions and provided an overview of our newly established partnership with GradGuard.
Here is your copy of the slideshow presentation <[[https://assets.flywire.com/documents/Flywire-Q4-Product-Insights-Open-Forum-Dec-2024.pdf]]> and you can access the webinar recording here <[[https://zoom.us/rec/play/JRVvAemUW_mfXhb_jsmq2t9jRXtwjAOXxG6h1YZD5OuYP1pVq4o7lcEnBN_DNVyGk3PnPjQ0Ea2P78-v.q0nSk7tu7kuzpz1E?autoplay=true]]> by entering your unique passcode: EDU1210*.
If you have any questions or would like to learn more about any of our education solutions, please reach out to your Relationship Manager or reply to this email.
And if your schedule allows, join us at 2PM EST today for an interactive webinar with NACUBO, one of our association partners, and higher education leaders from the University of Tennessee - Knoxville. Sign up for “Retention Strategies and Student Financial <[[https://www.nacubo.org/Events/2024/Retention-Strategies-and-Student-Financial-Literacy-Tips-for-2025-and-Beyond]]>Literacy <[[https://www.nacubo.org/Events/2024/Retention-Strategies-and-Student-Financial-Literacy-Tips-for-2025-and-Beyond]]> Tips <[[https://www.nacubo.org/Events/2024/Retention-Strategies-and-Student-Financial-Literacy-Tips-for-2025-and-Beyond]]>”to learn effective strategies to attract, engage and retain students.
Thank you!
The Flywire Team Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
